data.one_liner: A customizable piano keyboard widget for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides a piano keyboard UI that can be configured in size, note range, and appearance. Emits callbacks for note press, move, and release events.
use_when: You need an on‑screen piano keyboard in a Flutter app.
You want configurable note layout and callbacks without handling low‑level drawing yourself.
avoid_when: You require built‑in audio playback for notes.
You need advanced music theory features or MIDI sequencing.
strengths: Easy to drop into any Flutter project
weaknesses: Limited to UI; no music theory utilities
